# Lumière Jewels

> Hand-finished fine jewelry from the SoHo atelier at 143 Wooster Street, New York.
> Recycled 14k gold, ethically sourced diamonds, rhodium-plated sterling silver.
> Lifetime care (cleaning, re-plating, minor repairs) included with every piece.

Prices in USD. Holiday pricing: code LUMIERE15 gives 15% off.
Contact: hello@lumierejewels.com, (212) 555-0143. Reply within 1 business day.

## Collection

- [Aurora Pavé Band](https://lumierejewels.com/product/aurora-pave-band/): $245 (was $295). 14k gold vermeil · cubic zirconia. A whisper-thin band encircled with micro-pavé stones. Each of the 42 hand-set cubic zirconia catches light from every angle.
- [Étoile Diamond Pendant](https://lumierejewels.com/product/etoile-diamond-pendant/): $425 (was $495). 14k solid gold · 0.15 ct diamond. A single brilliant-cut diamond suspended from our signature fine chain. The bezel setting creates that coveted floating effect.
- [Nova Huggie Hoops](https://lumierejewels.com/product/nova-huggie-hoops/): $165 (was $195). 14k gold vermeil · pavé detail. Modern huggies that sit close to the ear with a subtle line of pavé stones along the outer edge.
- [Celestine Signet](https://lumierejewels.com/product/celestine-signet/): $185 (was $225). Sterling silver · hand-polished. A modern take on the classic signet with softened edges, a gently domed face, and a mirror polish that catches light like water.
- [Lumina Rope Chain](https://lumierejewels.com/product/lumina-rope-chain/): $145 (was $175). Sterling silver · Italian-made. A timeless rope chain with unexpected weight and drape. Made by fourth-generation silversmiths in Arezzo, Italy.
- [Twilight Drop Earrings](https://lumierejewels.com/product/twilight-drop-earrings/): $225 (was $265). Sterling silver · freshwater pearl. A sculptural ear wire flows into a single teardrop pearl. Movement without weight.
